description: This script processes Valgrind XML output files to generate a CSV report summarizing memory errors detected during testing. It scans a specified directory for XML files, parses error types, and summarizes the results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that creates a CSV report by scanning for Valgrind XML files, parsing errors, and writing results.

methods.name: ParseGtestXml
methods.description: Parses a Valgrind XML file to count different types of errors and determine if the test failed.
